name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She is caught mid-turn in a spinning cast, one leg lifted behind her, both arms sweeping upward in a spiral gesture that draws a column of stone shards, dust and glowing crystals around her, her head turned back to the camera with a bright, serene gaze. Casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: A shimmering column of stone shards, dust and glowing crystals, visible as streaming ribbons and {{MAGIC}} light, spirals around her.

notes: ELEGANT CASTING: a hands-only complex casting stance in her element.
